This traffic relief provided by a new facility would allow the local street system to function at a desirable service level for an extended period of time. The proposed ramps at Howell Avenue will give direct freeway access to traffic generated by the adjacent new commercial and industrial developments which otherwise will increase local street traffic.
The proposed project will substantially reduce accidents at the local street intersections in the area based upon reduced traffic.
The proposed Airport Spur Freeway is compatible with the Milwaukee Area Transit Plan in that the proposed south transit corridor of the North-South Freeway serves four major industrial areas, three major service and retail areas and General Mitchell Field. Modified rapid transit service can be provided using the freeway system without a spearate, exclusive facility.
Construction expenditures for improving the airport facilities and the proposed freeway project will boost the area's economy.
A prosperous community must have a viable airport that is easily accessible. An airport freeway facility directly connecting General Mitchell Field with the existing Interstate and Milwaukee County Freeway system will greatly increase the accessibility of the airport. It will provide safe, fast and efficient transportation, and will have a favorable economic and social effect on the area. It is compatible with long range planning for the airport. The proposed facility is consistent with regional goals and objectives and is in the public interest.
